name: engineering
description: Build and ship software — author and harden technical specs (writing-technical-specs, plan-hardening, spec-handoff-review), scan code for structural quality (code-quality-scan), generate code-verified documentation (document-codebase), and keep the repository tidy (prune-branches). Talk to GitHub (issues, PRs, repos, Actions) through the official remote MCP server; supply a GitHub personal access token to enable. Talk to Linear (issues, projects, cycles) through its official remote MCP server, authenticated via interactive OAuth (no token to configure).

GITHUB_PAT.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
GITHUB_PAT.description: A GitHub PAT (fine-grained or classic) sent as the Authorization: Bearer header to GitHub's official remote MCP server at https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/. Grant only the scopes you need (e.g. repo, read:org). Stored in your system keychain, never written to the repo; maintainer copy is SOPS-encrypted in secrets/github-pat.sops.json.
